title: Dil me akber ke hai sina baba
body:
Dil me akber ke hai sina baba
Jaa'n balab hai ye neemjaa'n baba
Aap ke hath thar tharaate hai
Dekh kar khainchiye sina baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhne mujhko aaye hai dekho
Daadijaa'n aur daadajaa'n baba
Aaap itna qayaal rakhiye ga
ran me aaye na meri maa baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera ye haal dekh kar warna
jaan dedegi meri maa baba
Ab to jaate hai hum khuda hafiz
Dam hai kuch dam ka mehmaa'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Reh gayi dil me nok barchi ki
aagayi hai labo'n pa jaa'n baba
kehkar akber ye mar gaye hilmi
qatm hoti hai daastaa'n baba
